topics.topic: Whether a repeated delivery must complete an orphaned image placement despite A6 rule 5, or refuse with state_unavailable
questions: When an image remains without a placement and A6 rule 5 applies on the repeated delivery, must that delivery complete the placement or refuse with state_unavailable?
Is the flow’s completion guarantee conditional on the repeated delivery reaching the write path without an A6 rule 5 refusal, or must it complete despite such a refusal?
When a failed placement-record write leaves an image and the retry encounters an A6 rule 5 refusal, does the retry refuse without completing the placement or complete it despite that refusal?

quotes:
After condition 5 a stored image may remain without a record: no caller has received
   its reference, and a repeated delivery of the same file writes it again and completes the placement,
   unless a refusal of A6 rule 5 applies.

An image left by a failed record write is completed by a
repeated delivery of the same file.
judgement.why: Both passages are unchanged from the texts with which State 4 was closed, and no subsequent change made their interaction matter differently.
